C*_r(Q) is separable, its unit is nonzero, it is simple (closed DGO 2.35), and it is generated by lambda(g1), lambda(g2), which are unitaries. printedRegularNonMFAlgebra_of_printedTorsionFreeTheorem derives TorsionFreePrinted.PrintedRegularNonMFAlgebra from thm:torsion-free as printed with no citation input. swarm-onesided-regular: proved with nothing assumed for every torsion-free, two-generated, acylindrically hyperbolic, non-MF Q. C*_r(Q) has a unique tracial state (closed DGO 2.35), has stable rank one (closed GO 1.1), and is stably finite and not MF (prop:mf-residual-calculus).
